result.instructions: Tools for Zenfulfillment, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are still pending or stuck with an invalid address?"; "Show the tracking numbers for the orders shipped this week."; "Which SKUs have fewer than 20 units on stock?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zenfulfillment data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zenfulfillment_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zenfulfillment_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zenfulfillment_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. zenfulfillment_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zenfulfillment_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List or search the fulfillment orders of this Zenfulfillment account (warehouse pick/pack/ship), with status, order reference, shop order number, totals, shipping and billing address, the products ordered/shipped and shipments (tracking number, carrier). Filter by ONE status, created/updated time or free text. The export has one row per product line; rows are grouped into orders. Paging: pass next_page back as page; an empty page is the end. GET /orders/export.

status.description: Only orders in this status (one at a time).

created_after.description: Only orders created at or after this time.

created_before.description: Only orders created at or before this time.

updated_after.description: Lower bound on the last update time (updatedAtMin).

updated_before.description: Upper bound on the last update time (updatedAtMax).

query.description: Free-text search: shipping street, city, country, zip, customer name, order number or ZF number.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Use the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: zenfulfillment_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order by its EXTERNAL reference, i.e. the order number from the connected shop or from your own import (for example 332-11-5599), with addresses, products with quantities (ordered, shipped, returned, refunded) and shipments with tracking numbers. Not the ZF reference: use zenfulfillment_list_orders with query for that. GET /orders/external/{reference}.

reference.description: External order reference (the shop's order number).

tools.name: zenfulfillment_list_stock
tools.title: List stock levels
tools.description: Stock on hand in the Zenfulfillment warehouse per SKU (sku, quantity_on_stock). Filter by SKU text and/or a maximum quantity to find low stock (then sorted lowest first). GET /products/export.

max_quantity.description: Only SKUs with at most this many units on stock (use for low-stock checks).

tools.name: zenfulfillment_list_inventory_shipments
tools.title: List inbound shipments
tools.description: List inbound inventory shipments (goods you sent to the warehouse) with reference, SKU lines, announced quantity, quantity arrived and note. Filter by ONE status, created/updated time or free text (ZF number, tracking code, type). Rows are grouped per shipment. Paging as in list_orders. GET /inventory_shipments/export.

status.description: Only shipments in this status (one at a time).

created_after.description: Only shipments created at or after this time.

created_before.description: Only shipments created at or before this time.

updated_after.description: Lower bound on the last update time (updatedAtMin).

updated_before.description: Upper bound on the last update time (updatedAtMax).

query.description: Free-text search: ZF number, tracking code, type.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Use the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: zenfulfillment_get_inventory_shipment
tools.title: Get inbound shipment
tools.description: One inbound inventory shipment by its ZF reference (for example ZF01123700): SKU lines with announced and arrived quantities and the note. GET /inventory_shipments/export/{reference}/reference.

reference.description: Inventory shipment ZF reference, e.g. ZF01123700.

tools.name: zenfulfillment_list_returns
tools.title: List returns
tools.description: List returns processed by the warehouse (PROCESSED = received, DONE = marked refunded), with the return's `_id` (needed by zenfulfillment_mark_return_done), ZF reference, note, products with quantity, reason, condition and whether they were actually returned, and the original order. Filter by ONE status, time or free text. Paging as in list_orders. GET /returns/export.

created_after.description: Only returns created at or after this time.

created_before.description: Only returns created at or before this time.

updated_after.description: Lower bound on the last update time (updatedAtMin).

updated_before.description: Upper bound on the last update time (updatedAtMax).

query.description: Free-text search: street, city, country, zip, customer name, order number or ZF number.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Use the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: zenfulfillment_import_order
tools.title: Create or update an order
tools.description: WRITE: send ONE order to the Zenfulfillment warehouse for picking, packing and shipping to the given address (fulfillment and shipping fees apply per the contract). The reference is your own order number: a reference that already exists UPDATES that order instead of creating a new one. Each item becomes one CSV row (Reference;Date;Name;Company;Street1;Street2;Zip Code;City;Region;Country;Email;Phone;SKU;Quantity). Use SKUs from zenfulfillment_list_stock. Check the address with the user first. In test mode nothing ships. POST /orders/import.

reference.description: Your own order reference/number (for example Bestellung1). An existing reference updates that order.

email.description: Recipient email (carriers use it for tracking notices).

phone.description: Recipient phone number. A leading + is sent as 00 (international prefix) so spreadsheets never read it as a formula.

sku.description: SKU exactly as in the warehouse (see zenfulfillment_list_stock).

tools.name: zenfulfillment_cancel_orders
tools.title: Cancel orders
tools.description: WRITE, cannot be undone: cancel orders by reference (up to 50). Only orders that can still be cancelled (before the warehouse has packed or shipped them) are cancelled; the others come back in `errors`. Confirm the references with the user first. POST /orders/cancel.

references.description: Order references to cancel (as in the Reference column, e.g. the ZF reference or your own order number).

tools.name: zenfulfillment_mark_return_done
tools.title: Mark return as refunded
tools.description: WRITE: set a return's status to DONE (refunded) in Zenfulfillment. Zenfulfillment only records the status; refund the customer in your shop yourself. Use the `_id` from zenfulfillment_list_returns (not the ZF reference). Cannot be set back through the API. POST /returns/{returnId}/done.
